ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict drug, protein and host-pathogen interactions
ranked.summary: Graph-based deep learning is being combined with multimodal fusion and explainability to predict biological and chemical interactions for drug and target…

ranked.headline: Soil plasmidomes and Hi-C virus-host benchmarks extend microbial mobile-gene mining
ranked.summary: Large plasmid and virus-host resources now come paired with explicit benchmarks or ecological context, tying mobile genes to their hosts.

ranked.headline: Deep models align histology, spatial transcriptomics, and unpaired single-cell data
ranked.summary: Preprints this month pair histology, spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, and unpaired single-cell data with deep alignment and translation models.

ranked.headline: Sequence-based deep learning predicts protein binding and functional properties
ranked.summary: Learned protein language model embeddings now support sequence-only prediction of binding affinity, interactions, and allergenicity.

ranked.headline: Temporally resolved single-cell data fitted to dynamical models infer cell behavior
ranked.summary: Minute-scale scRNA-seq and multi-omic velocity models now resolve dynamic cell-state transitions beyond static embeddings.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence and protein-language scores now prioritize non-coding and rare variants
ranked.summary: Learned models now convert sequence and protein-language predictions into candidate variant and regulatory-element prioritizations for association testing.

ranked.headline: Sampling frames and primer design decide which microbial lineages enter analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications show that primer, metadata, and sampling choices shape which pathogen and gut lineages are detected.

ranked.headline: Interaction-aware neural models decode EEG, SEEG, ECoG and connectome structure
ranked.summary: A published study and four preprints model inter-channel and cross-subject neural interactions for decoding.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer cell types and spatial expression from transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Benchmarks of imaging spatial platforms and spatial gene selection now directly test cell-typing and spatial reconstruction methods on shared tissue data.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic models infer disease-specific metabolic states and regulatory circuits
ranked.summary: Integrating multi-omic data with genome-scale and regulatory network models now resolves metabolic states at patient, cell, and pan-cancer scales.

ranked.headline: Foundation models predict regulatory activity and 3D chromatin from DNA sequence
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence encoders are now coupled to Hi-C data and benchmarked on dependencies up to 1 Mb in recent preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map non-canonical RNA and DNA structures and gene loss at scale
ranked.summary: Transcriptome-wide and genome-scale analyses increasingly require automated tools that score structure-forming sequences, variant effects, and gene loss.

ranked.headline: Learned models and benchmarks for genomic variation, expression and mutation rates
ranked.summary: Learned models and long-read benchmarks now target diploid genomic variation, expression and splicing, extending beyond reference-only inputs.

ranked.headline: Population-scale genomes resolve diversity, domestication and inherited methylation
ranked.summary: Population-scale sequencing of pear, macaque and grapevine now yields variant, diversity and methylation resources for reuse by expert groups.

ranked.headline: Gapless and population-scale references set new baselines for genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Gapless Korean T2T assembly and 10,239-genome multiomic data now appear together as population-matched reference resources.

ranked.headline: Generative models now design ligands, peptides and binders conditioned on 3D structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend structure-conditioned generation to holo pockets, all-atom outputs, and D-peptide design.

ranked.headline: Sequence and nucleosomes govern chromatin structure and methylation-dependent binding
ranked.summary: Structure-aware models now link linker DNA, nucleosome positioning, and CpG methylation to chromatin organization across multiple scales.

ranked.headline: Frameworks couple mechanistic models with ML calibration and noise-aware inference
ranked.summary: Hybrid modelling tools now pair mechanistic models with inference methods for sparse, noisy and multi-laboratory biological data.

ranked.headline: Causal and enrichment criteria are qualifying network-derived biological predictions
ranked.summary: Network-derived target candidates are increasingly checked against causal priors, enrichment statistics, and standardized benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Energetic and dynamic characterization of protein structures and ligand binding
ranked.summary: Structure-derived energy matrices, Markov state models and MD with NMR now quantify protein energetics, disordered-protein binding and allosteric dynamics.

ranked.headline: Language models guide generative redesign of proteins and de novo genes
ranked.summary: Generative models now redesign proteins and genes conditioned on structural, evolutionary and genomic context rather than sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Generative and transport models infer single-cell dynamics and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple learned low-dimensional encoders with optimal transport and Schrödinger Bridge constraints for single-cell prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Membrane geometry and gradients set local-rule-driven oscillation and ion homeostasis
ranked.summary: Recent models link membrane geometry, multi-compartment transport and protein diffusion to system-level outputs arising from local physical rules.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and inference applied directly to raw single-trace and image data
ranked.summary: Near-raw measurements such as intensity traces, current traces, and microscopy images are now analyzed directly by learning and inference methods.

ranked.headline: Genomic language models learn adaptive tokens and scale context inference
ranked.summary: Genomic language models are being reframed around learned tokenization, in-context learning, and cheaper long-context inference over DNA.

ranked.headline: LLM and network methods link longitudinal blood, gene literature, and therapeutic data
ranked.summary: Literature-scale and longitudinal biomedical records are increasingly converted into queryable networks that support causal, gene-level, and therapeutic…

ranked.headline: Near-T2T cattle genome, Y-haplogroup calling workflow, and standardized assembly metrics
ranked.summary: Each item packages a reference, workflow, or metric in a form others can reproduce and apply directly to their own genomic data.

ranked.headline: SIMD, GPU and diagonal-partitioning methods speed up sequence alignment and motif analysis
ranked.summary: Recent published and preprint tools report large throughput gains for alignment, read simulation and metagenomic workflows.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict HIV diagnoses, protein succinylation, and RNA methylation sites
ranked.summary: Mobility-aware graphs and multi-view contrastive learning are now applied to epidemiological and sequence-based site prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Dynamics analysis and NMR-guided sampling sharpen protein conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent items pair open-source analysis packages with NMR-informed coarse-grained MD and AFM-based conformational reconstruction.

ranked.headline: Open-source R workflows span information-theoretic, spatial, and multi-omics analyses
ranked.summary: Recent releases package information-theoretic similarity and surprisal methods alongside reproducible R pipelines for spatial and multi-omics data.

ranked.headline: Explicit computational decision rules encoded in RNA, DNA, and splicing analysis tools
ranked.summary: Openly described tools now encode statistical criteria explicitly, though none of these reports runtime or cross-tool reproducibility outcomes.

ranked.headline: Symbolic and thermodynamic models link network structure to reaction dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study extend structure-based kinetic and thermodynamic modeling of reaction networks across engineered and metabolic systems.

ranked.headline: Omitted epistasis biases GWAS nulls; multivariate and metabolite QTL maps expand loci
ranked.summary: Large multivariate GWAS and plasma metabolome atlases now pair genetic association with causal screening across common diseases.

ranked.headline: Network models separate direct from indirect gene transfers and refine amplicon units
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply network and evolutionary models to bacterial gene exchange, 16S amplicon units, and CRISPR array orientation.

ranked.headline: Simulations and assays map lipid transfer and pore routes in membrane remodeling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints resolve gating in ATG2A lipid transfer and stalk-pore routes for lipid nanoparticle endosomal escape.

ranked.headline: Learning rules and circuit architecture are being fit to behavior and neural dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent studies fit learning rules and circuit architecture to human trial-level reaction times, spiking basal ganglia circuits, and working-memory learning in…

ranked.headline: Open-source LLM agents map natural-language queries onto curated biological databases
ranked.summary: Open-source LLM agents now answer genomic and cohort queries, reported to match GeneGPT or outperform GPT-4o on benchmarks.

ranked.headline: Delay-coupled oscillators, network size, and frequency allocation shape synchrony regimes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie network size, propagation delay, and frequency allocation to resonance and transition behavior in coupled neural oscillator networks.

ranked.headline: Noise, dispersal, and nutrient limits reshape predator-prey population dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints formalize how noise, spatial coupling, nutrient co-limitation, and network structure constrain stochastic ecological dynamics.
